description: QC-001b Shor TWIN projection. Post ONE half, receive the other. Post halfPow a (a^2 == 1 mod N, a != +/-1) and the court projects factor/cofactor by gcd(a-1,N) and gcd(a+1,N). Post factor and cofactor and it projects a by CRT (a == 1 mod factor, a == -1 mod cofactor). The projected half is verified before return. Bijection in polynomial time - it does not search for a period and does not derive a discrete log. Decimal strings; empty means not posted. Floats refused.
name: project_shor_twin
